findings.highlight: I put strength into my grip
findings.evidenceJa: 木刀に力をこめる
findings.governingReading: I pour strength into the wooden sword
findings.explanation: Shirou reinforces or braces the weapon itself; the English relocates the force to his hand.

findings.highlight: hit right in the center of her body
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の中心を点穴され
findings.governingReading: struck at a vital pressure point in the center of her chest
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s precise pressure-point strike is reduced to an anatomically vague hit.

findings.highlight: about a meter or so
findings.evidenceJa: 一メートル弱
findings.governingReading: just under one meter
findings.explanation: The retreat distance is rounded upward and made less precise.

findings.highlight: “Kuh[line4]!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「しっ[line4]！」
findings.governingReading: “Shh—!”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s sharp exertion sound becomes a groan, changing his physical delivery as he intercepts Kuzuki.

findings.highlight: My strengthened wooden sword was like metal
findings.evidenceJa: 強化された木刀は鉄と同じだ
findings.governingReading: The strengthened wooden sword is equivalent to steel
findings.explanation: A specific comparison to iron or steel is weakened into the broad category “metal.”

findings.highlight: Having my head smashed off, I would probably splatter a rain of blood and brains.
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄槌めいたソレで、衛宮士郎は死ぬだろう
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou will die from that hammer-like blow
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch adds decapitation and a rain of blood and brains absent from the active Japanese narration.

findings.highlight: Not a quickly-furnished weapon like a wooden sword
findings.evidenceJa: 木刀なんて急造のものじゃなく
findings.governingReading: not an improvised thing like a wooden sword
findings.explanation: An urgently improvised substitute is described with the unnatural furnishing of an object.

findings.highlight: a proven, strong weapon
findings.evidenceJa: 鍛え上げられた強い武器
findings.governingReading: a strong weapon forged and tempered to completion
findings.explanation: The weapon’s material formation and refinement are replaced by prior proof of performance.

findings.highlight: Trace, on.
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=トレース char=2]投影、[ruby text=オン o2o=1]開始
findings.governingReading: Projection, read as “Trace”; Start, read as “On”
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains only the spoken ruby readings and deletes the written magecraft operation and initiation terms.

findings.highlight: It does not matter if something gets destroyed in the process
findings.evidenceJa: 故障してもいい、どこかを失ってもかまわない
findings.governingReading: It is fine if I break; I do not care if I lose some part of myself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s willingness to sacrifice his own bodily integrity is depersonalized into unspecified process damage.

findings.highlight: I’m not the only one who’ll be killed
findings.evidenceJa: 壊れるのはおまえだけじゃない
findings.governingReading: You are not the only one who will break
findings.explanation: The repeated machinery and bodily-breakage language becomes literal death, overstating the immediate outcome and losing the self-objectifying metaphor.

findings.highlight: A deep voice
findings.evidenceJa: くぐもった声
findings.governingReading: A muffled voice
findings.explanation: Sound quality caused by obstruction or impaired hearing is changed into vocal pitch.

findings.highlight: Only my right eye is functioning
findings.evidenceJa: 満足な右目だけが生きている
findings.governingReading: Only my intact right eye remains alive
findings.explanation: The fact that the right eye is his sole undamaged faculty is reduced to function.

findings.highlight: I observe as someone else’s action blocks the attack
findings.evidenceJa: それを防いでいる、他人事を観察する
findings.governingReading: I observe my defense of it as though it were someone else’s affair
findings.explanation: Shirou’s dissociation from his own automatic defense is turned into an unidentified other person blocking Kuzuki.

findings.highlight: My arms are about to rip off.
findings.evidenceJa: 腕が空っぽになったみたい
findings.governingReading: My arms feel hollow
findings.explanation: The mature-text branch replaces numb hollowness with imminent physical severing.

findings.highlight: I can’t project you guys perfectly with my skills
findings.evidenceJa: 今の俺では、おまえたちを投影しきる事が出来ない
findings.governingReading: As I am now, I cannot complete the projection of you two
findings.explanation: A limit of Shirou’s present state and incomplete projection becomes a generic shortage of skill.

findings.highlight: The twin swords that parried thirty attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 三十もの拳を弾いた双剣
findings.governingReading: The twin swords that deflected fully thirty punches
findings.explanation: The repeated specific collision with Kuzuki’s fists is generalized to attacks.

findings.highlight: A strong wind is created in the intersection
findings.evidenceJa: 強い風が、交差点に巻き起こった
findings.governingReading: A strong wind whirls up through the intersection
findings.explanation: An observed wind arising is made into an unexplained act of creation.

findings.highlight: that extra thinking caused her to lose out on her perfect chance
findings.evidenceJa: その余分が確実な勝機を逸した
findings.governingReading: that unnecessary detour cost her a certain victory
findings.explanation: Caster’s unspecified extra objective or action is narrowed to thought itself.

findings.highlight: I should have attacked her one more time
findings.evidenceJa: あと一芸、手を凝らすべきだった
findings.governingReading: I should have devised one more artifice
findings.explanation: Kuzuki regrets insufficient tactical variation; the English says he merely needed another repetition of the same attack, contradicting why it will not work twice.

findings.highlight: the difference between a “technique” that is trained to an art, and an “action” that is trained to the utmost limits
findings.evidenceJa: 芸術にまで磨き上げられた“技”と、極限にまで鍛え上げられた“業”の違い
findings.governingReading: the difference between technique polished into art and craft trained to its utmost limit
findings.explanation: The key `技／業` contrast is reduced to “technique versus action,” and polished refinement is described as training an object into art.

findings.highlight: Caster’s robe flutters as she finishes
findings.evidenceJa: 忌々しげに吐き捨て
findings.governingReading: Caster spits the words out bitterly
findings.explanation: Caster’s resentment and biting delivery vanish, weakening the ambiguity over whom her remark targets.

findings.highlight: as if through sorcery
findings.evidenceJa: それこそ魔法のように
findings.governingReading: as if by true magic itself
findings.explanation: A comparison using Fate’s distinct term for true Magic is normalized to sorcery, blurring the work’s technical hierarchy.
